basic_details.job_title: TMC Clinical Research Coordinator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The H.R.D. Department of Tata Memorial Hospital, Tata Memorial Centre (a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India), has invited online applications for one Clinical Research Coordinator post under the "CRS & DAE-CTC" Project (A/c. No.0963), initially for a period of six months, at TMH, Parel. The essential qualification is M.Sc in Life Science / M. Pharm with a mandatory PG Diploma in Clinical research, or M.Sc in Clinical research, with 2 years' experience. The age limit is 35 years. rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre, Tata Memorial Hospital, H.R.D. Department
Initially for a period of six months

content_sections.heading: About TMC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre is a Grant-In-Aid Institute of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, and this notice is issued by the H.R.D. Department of Tata Memorial Hospital. The post is for the "CRS & DAE-CTC" Project (A/c. No.0963) and is located at TMH, Parel.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints the following for the Clinical Research Coordinator post (1 vacancy): Experience: 2 Years' Experience is Mandatory. Age limit: 35 Years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Candidates are requested to appear for the position only if all the required course certificates are completed and available. Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/Principal Investigator. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification_required: M.sc in Life Science/ M. Pharm; PG Diploma in Clinical research is Mandatory; Or M.sc in Clinical research

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is under the "CRS & DAE-CTC" Project (A/c. No.0963), initially for a period of six months. The notice does not mention allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Clinical Research Coordinator
content_sections.text: Send your candidature through the "Online Application" only, at https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx . Submit it by 27/11/2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time). Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Keep a valid email ID. All correspondence is by email only, and the interview date will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. Tata Memorial Centre does not take responsibility for non-receipt of an application through the online system. Documents named in the notice: Online application form, to be carried to the interview. Original documents with one set of copies supporting the qualifications and experience given in the online application form. NOC from the current HOD/Principal Investigator, for internal candidates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be initially screened, and eligible candidates will be called for interview. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called to a reasonable limit on the basis of qualifications and experience. Mere fulfilling the prescribed qualifications will not entitle an applicant to be called. Tata Memorial Centre also reserves the right not to call any candidate for interview without assigning any reason. Candidates who do not carry the online application form and original documents with one set of copies will not be allowed to appear for the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility criteria, or has furnished incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed any material fact at any stage, the candidature will be cancelled. If any shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. The candidate is responsible for receiving, downloading and printing the related documents. For enquiries, call 24177000 Extn. 4664 or email [email protected] .
